#environment

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(nlme)
library(emmeans)
library(interactions)
library(car)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(effectsize)

setwd() #set WD here
df <- read.csv('bw_distract_experimental_data.csv')

#confirm expected sample size of 115
length(unique(df$share_id))

```

#demographics - child level (table 1)

```{r}

df_wide <- df %>%
  group_by(share_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(share_id,
                condition_1,
                child_age:fam_incometoneeds)

```

##child level (table 1)

```{r}

#ALL (N=115)

#age at 36-months session
df_wide %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(child_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(child_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    min  = min(child_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(child_age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

#sex
df_wide %>%
  dplyr::count(child_sex) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

#race
df_wide %>%
  dplyr::count(child_race) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

#ethnicity
df_wide %>%
  dplyr::count(child_eth) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

#BY CONDITION

#age at 36-months session
df_wide %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition_1) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(child_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(child_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    min  = min(child_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(child_age, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

#sex
df_wide %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition_1) %>%
  dplyr::count(child_sex) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

#race
df_wide %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition_1) %>%
  dplyr::count(child_race) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

#ethnicity
df_wide %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition_1) %>%
  dplyr::count(child_eth) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

#GROUP DIFFERENCES

#age at 36-months session
t.test(child_age ~ condition_1, data = df_wide)

#sex
csex <- table(df_wide$condition_1,df_wide$child_sex)
chisq.test(csex, correct = FALSE)

#race (some cell sizes <5 so doing Fisher's exact test)
crace <- table(df_wide$condition_1,df_wide$child_race)
fisher.test(crace)

#ethnicity 
ceth <- table(df_wide$condition_1,df_wide$child_eth)
chisq.test(ceth)

#No difference between kids randomized to bw vs distract first on baby demographics 
```

#knot selection: create time variables

```{r}

#knot 1

#create piecewise time variables person-centered 10 sec after the condition 
df_1 <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(share_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    #identify when instruction starts + 1 segments
    knot = which(Episode_description == 'Experiment 1')[1] + 1,
    #time leading up to the knot
    epoch_pc_pre_1 = if_else(row_number() <= knot,
                             row_number() - knot,
                             0),
    #time after the knot
    epoch_pc_post_1 = if_else(row_number() > knot,
                              row_number() - knot,
                              0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-knot)

#create quadratic term after knot
df_1$epoch_pc_post_1_quad <- df_1$epoch_pc_post_1^2

#convert condition to binary 0/1 for easier interpretation
df_1$condition_1_bin <- ifelse(df_1$condition_1 == "distract", 0, 1) 

#confirm conversion
table(df_1$condition_1, df_1$condition_1_bin)

#knot 2

#create piecewise time variables person-centered 20 sec after the condition (pre and post knot)
df_2 <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(share_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    #identify when instruction starts + 1 segments
    knot = which(Episode_description == 'Experiment 1')[1] + 2,
    #time leading up to the knot
    epoch_pc_pre_2 = if_else(row_number() <= knot,
                             row_number() - knot,
                             0),
    #time after the knot
    epoch_pc_post_2 = if_else(row_number() > knot,
                              row_number() - knot,
                              0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-knot)

#create quadratic term after knot
df_2$epoch_pc_post_2_quad <- df_2$epoch_pc_post_2^2

#convert condition to binary 0/1 for easier interpretation
df_2$condition_1_bin <- ifelse(df_2$condition_1 == "distract", 0, 1)

#confirm conversion
table(df_2$condition_1, df_2$condition_1_bin)

#knot 3

#create piecewise time variables person-centered 10 sec after the condition (pre and post knot)
df_3 <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(share_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    #identify when instruction starts + 1 segments
    knot = which(Episode_description == 'Experiment 1')[1] + 3,
    #time leading up to the knot
    epoch_pc_pre_3 = if_else(row_number() <= knot,
                             row_number() - knot,
                             0),
    #time after the knot
    epoch_pc_post_3 = if_else(row_number() > knot,
                              row_number() - knot,
                              0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-knot)

#create quadratic term after knot
df_3$epoch_pc_post_3_quad <- df_3$epoch_pc_post_3^2

#convert condition to binary 0/1 for easier interpretation (distract is reference group)
df_3$condition_1_bin <- ifelse(df_3$condition_1 == "distract", 0, 1)

#confirm conversion
table(df_3$condition_1, df_3$condition_1_bin)

```

#knot selection: test models with each knot 

```{r}

#knot 1

#create person-centered time coding variable
df_1$epoch <- df_1$epoch_pc_pre_1 + df_1$epoch_pc_post_1

condition_pc1 <- 
  lme(
    affect_code ~  
      epoch_pc_pre_1 + 
      epoch_pc_post_1 * condition_1_bin + 
      epoch_pc_post_1_quad * condition_1_bin, 
    data = df_1,
    random = ~ epoch_pc_post_1 | share_id, #random linear growth only 
    #(add "+ epoch_pc_post_1_quad" after epoch_pc_post_1 for random quadratic growth)
    method = "REML",
    na.action = na.exclude,
    correlation = corAR1(form = ~ epoch | share_id) #autocorrelation
  )

summary(condition_pc1)

#knot 2

#create person-centered time coding variable
df_2$epoch <- df_2$epoch_pc_pre_2 + df_2$epoch_pc_post_2

condition_pc2 <- 
  lme(
    affect_code ~  
      epoch_pc_pre_2 + 
      epoch_pc_post_2 * condition_1_bin + 
      epoch_pc_post_2_quad * condition_1_bin, 
    data = df_2,
    random = ~ epoch_pc_post_2 | share_id, #random linear and nonlinear growht
    method = "REML",
    na.action = na.exclude,
    correlation = corAR1(form = ~ epoch | share_id)
  )

summary(condition_pc2)

#knot 3

#create person-centered time coding variable 
df_3$epoch <- df_3$epoch_pc_pre_3 + df_3$epoch_pc_post_3

condition_pc3 <- 
  lme(
    affect_code ~ 
      epoch_pc_pre_3 + 
      epoch_pc_post_3 * condition_1_bin + 
      epoch_pc_post_3_quad * condition_1_bin, 
    data = df_3,
    random = ~ epoch_pc_post_3 | share_id,
    method = "REML",
    na.action = na.exclude,
    correlation = corAR1(form = ~ epoch | share_id)
  )

summary(condition_pc3)

```

#knot selection: compare fit 
Model 1 with knot at 10 sec fits the data the best per AIC and BIC

```{r}

options(digits = 6)
AIC(condition_pc1, condition_pc2, condition_pc3)
BIC(condition_pc1, condition_pc2, condition_pc3)


```

#summary of model 1 with knot at 10 sec

```{r}

#print statistics 
summary(condition_pc1)$tTable
intervals(condition_pc1, which = "fixed") #get 95% CI

#get linear and quadratic trajectories for bw 
emtrends(condition_pc1, ~ condition_1_bin, var = "epoch_pc_post_1")
emtrends(condition_pc1, ~ condition_1_bin, var = "epoch_pc_post_1_quad")

```

#plot 

```{r}

df_complete_1 <- df_1 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(epoch_pc_pre_1), 
         !is.na(epoch_pc_post_1), 
         !is.na(epoch_pc_post_1_quad),
         !is.na(condition_1))

#extracted model-implied fixed-effects 
mm        <- model.matrix(formula(condition_pc1)[-2], data = df_complete_1)
fixed     <- fixef(condition_pc1)
vcov_mat  <- vcov(condition_pc1)

fit    <- as.numeric(mm %*% fixed)
se_fit <- sqrt(diag(mm %*% vcov_mat %*% t(mm)))

df_complete_1 <- df_complete_1 %>%
  mutate(
    predicted         = fit,
    ci_lower          = fit - 1.96 * se_fit,
    ci_upper          = fit + 1.96 * se_fit,
    predicted_subject = predict(condition_pc1, newdata = df_complete_1, level = 1),
    time_sec          = epoch_pc_post_1 * 10
  )

df_mean <- df_complete_1 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(epoch_pc_post_1, condition_1) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    predicted = mean(predicted, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_lower  = mean(ci_lower,  na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_upper  = mean(ci_upper,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(time_sec = epoch_pc_post_1 * 10)

#plot
plot1 <- ggplot(df_complete_1, aes(x = time_sec)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted_subject, group = share_id, color = condition_1),
            alpha = 0.08, linewidth = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_ribbon(data = df_mean,
              aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper, fill = condition_1),
              alpha = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = df_mean,
            aes(y = predicted, color = condition_1),
            linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(data = df_mean,
             aes(y = predicted, color = condition_1),
             size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("bw" = "#AA3377", "distract" = "#44AA99"),
    labels = c("bw" = "Being-with", "distract" = "Distraction"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("bw" = "#AA3377", "distract" = "#44AA99"),
    labels = c("bw" = "Being-with", "distract" = "Distraction"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 90)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 90, by = 10)) +
  labs(x = "Time (seconds)", y = "Model-Implied Affect") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    axis.line          = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title       = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = c(0.82, 0.12),
    legend.background  = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.5),
    legend.margin      = margin(3, 5, 3, 5)
  )

ggsave("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Julia personal files/SEA Lab/Papers/Frustration_Self-regulation/Main analyses/figures/affect_condition.png", plot = plot1, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```

#pairwise differences in affect

```{r}

#on average kids have 10 epoch post-exp 1
df %>%
  dplyr::filter(episode == 2) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(share_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_ep2 = n()) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(avg_ep2 = mean(n_ep2))

#reprint final model
condition_pc1_v2 <- lme(
  affect_code ~  
    epoch_pc_pre_1 + 
    epoch_pc_post_1 * condition_1_bin + 
    I(epoch_pc_post_1^2) * condition_1_bin, 
  data = df_1,
  random = ~ epoch_pc_post_1 | share_id,
  method = "REML",
  na.action = na.exclude,
  correlation = corAR1(form = ~ epoch | share_id)
)

summary(condition_pc1_v2)$tTable

#pairwise contrast at each post-knot epoch
emm <- emmeans(condition_pc1_v2,
               ~ condition_1_bin | epoch_pc_post_1,
               at = list(epoch_pc_post_1 = 1:10)) #10 epochs

contrasts_by_epoch <- contrast(emm, method = "pairwise")
summary(contrasts_by_epoch, infer = TRUE, adjust = "bonferroni")

```

```{r}
emtrends(condition_pc1_filt, ~ condition_1_bin, var = "epoch_pc_post_1")
```


#supplementary analysis testing whether children higher in EC show different responses to the intervention 
Test EC x condition interaction

```{r}

#child-level EC (z-scored across children)
ec_child <- df_1 %>%
  distinct(share_id, cbq_effcon) %>%
  mutate(effcon_z = as.numeric(scale(cbq_effcon)))

#add EC and each child's baseline affect back to df
df_ec <- df_1 %>%
  left_join(ec_child, by = "share_id") %>%
  group_by(share_id) %>%
  mutate(pre_mean = mean(affect_code[epoch <= -2], na.rm = TRUE)) %>% #baseline excludes instruction segment (epoch -1)
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(epoch >= 0, !is.na(effcon_z), is.finite(pre_mean))

#condition x EC on post-instruction affect
m_ec <- lme(
  affect_code ~ pre_mean + epoch_pc_post_1 + condition_1_bin * effcon_z,
  data = df_ec,
  random = ~ 1 | share_id,
  correlation = corAR1(form = ~ epoch | share_id),
  method = "REML",
  na.action = na.exclude
)

summary(m_ec)$tTable
intervals(m_ec, which = "fixed")

```
